description: Cache original web pages locally with `web cache serve`, a caching reverse proxy for iterative migration work. Navigate pages through it (manually or with a browser) and every resource is saved to disk; restart it offline to replay the full site with no network, bot detection or rate limits. Triggers on: page cache, cache page, cache site, cache website, offline cache, warm cache, cache proxy, page-cache, site mirror, cache for migration.
